messages:
Maria G: Quick pre-deploy check for release v2.16 — aiming for tonight 23:00 UTC. Owners: AJ (deploy), Kevin (smoke), Olivia (monitor). Can each owner ack and confirm rollback readiness?

AJ: Ack — I can own the deploy. I plan a canary at 10% for 15m then 50% for 10m if metrics look good. Target window 23:00-23:30 UTC.

Kevin L: Smoke harness is green. Smoke checklist link: https://internal.redwood/smoke/v2.16 (runbook + tests). I will run smoke after canary reaches 50% and report results. Acceptance: 99th p50 latency within 15% of baseline, no error-rate spike >0.5%.

Olivia S: I will watch latency/egress dashboards and logs. I’ll keep alerts unmuted. If error-rate hits 0.5% I’ll ping and start rollback.

sre-oncall: Please reserve fallback capacity and confirm autoscaler cooldown values. Also set circuit-breaker to degrade to smaller model variant on sustained latency. Suggest canary 10% for 20m to watch memory/KV behavior.

AJ: Noted. Autoscaler cooldown is 120s currently; I’ll bump to 180s for the window. Canary 10% x 20m -> then 50% x 10m -> full.

Maria G: Rollback command and quick steps? Put them here so support can act fast.

AJ: Rollback command (one-liner):
```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service inference-api --to-tag v2.15 --force --reason "canary-failure"
```
Manual steps after rollback: flush KV cache: `redis-cli -h redis.prod flushall` (notify ops first).

Kevin L: Smoke run results to post here after canary 50%. I’ll attach short pass/fail and a 1-line reason if fail.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job created: job/rdw-deploy-v2.16 at 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z. Canary policy: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Notify channel on each step.

Olivia S: One more ask — enable request tracing sampling at 100% for the canary window for 30m so we can debug any tail latency. I’ll disable after 30m.

AJ: Will enable tracing sampling during canary.

Maria G: Excellent. Final signoffs: AJ (deploy) :white_check_mark:, Kevin (smoke) :white_check_mark:, Olivia (monitor) :white_check_mark:, sre-oncall :white_check_mark:. If anyone needs to change timing, speak now. Otherwise proceed with 23:00 UTC window. :rocket:
